id.instruksi: Paket internet rumah habis, tetapi router Wi-Fi tetap menyala dan HP tidak punya kuota. Seret tiap kegiatan: cukup jaringan rumah, butuh internet, atau tidak butuh jaringan?
id.i1: mencetak foto ke printer di kamar ayah lewat Wi-Fi rumah
id.i2: mengirim lagu ke HP ibu lewat Bluetooth
id.i4: menyalin foto dari HP ke laptop lewat Wi-Fi rumah
id.i6: main game berdua di dua tablet lewat Wi-Fi rumah
id.i12: main game daring bersama teman di kota lain
id.i13: membaca buku digital yang sudah diunduh
id.i18: bermain catur melawan komputer di laptop

en.instruksi: The home internet plan has run out, but the Wi-Fi router is still on and the phone has no mobile data. Drag each activity: home network is enough, needs the internet, or needs no network?
en.bin-lokal: home Wi-Fi or Bluetooth is enough
en.i1: printing a photo on the printer in Dad's room over home Wi-Fi
en.i2: sending a song to Mum's phone by Bluetooth
en.i3: connecting Bluetooth headphones to a laptop
en.i4: copying photos from the phone to a laptop over home Wi-Fi
en.i5: using a Bluetooth mouse with a laptop
en.i6: playing a two-player game on two tablets over home Wi-Fi
en.i7: sending a message in a chat app
en.i10: updating an app on the phone
en.i12: playing an online game with a friend in another city
en.i13: reading an e-book you already downloaded
en.i16: recording your voice on the phone
en.i17: setting an alarm on the phone
en.i18: playing chess against the computer on a laptop

binCount.keterangan: 2 = jaringan lokal vs internet; 3 = tambah kegiatan tanpa jaringan (ulang SD 3)
